fields.text: **Link protocol for conversation audit source:** Replaced `../conversation://8b733dfa-645a-478e-b6cc-e08c50620730` in the disposition table preamble with `conversation://8b733dfa-645a-478e-b6cc-e08c50620730` so the custom URI scheme parses cleanly as an active link rather than a broken relative filesystem path.

**Relative link repairs in archived doc:** When moving `lvgl-display-design.md` into `docs/archive/`, adjusted relative paths (`../modules/LVGLDisplay/README.md` → `../../modules/LVGLDisplay/README.md`, `developer/*.md` → `../developer/*.md`, `design_specification.md` → `../design_specification.md`) to avoid broken links.
